title: 塑料为什么不会烂
subtitle: 它太新了，虫子不认识它
character: wearing a bright teal t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, friendly flat cartoon art with clean rounded outlines and flat colours, teal, coral and cream, simple shapes, calm and clear

pages.zh:
我在公园的草丛里
捡到一个塑料瓶。
上面沾满了泥，
可是它一点也没坏。
它在这儿多久了呢？
pages.scene: The little boy crouches in grass holding a muddy plastic bottle, looking at it with a small frown.

pages.zh:
树叶掉在地上，
过一个冬天就烂了。
因为土里有很多小虫子
和看不见的细菌，
它们会把树叶吃掉。
pages.scene: One leaf on soil on a cream background, half broken down, with small specks around its edge. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这个过程叫「降解」。
树叶、果皮、木头，
都能被吃掉，
最后变回土。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three stages in a row on a cream background: a whole leaf, a partly eaten leaf, and a small heap of soil. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
可是塑料不行。
塑料是人做出来的，
只有一百多年。
土里那些小东西
从来没见过它，不会吃。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rows on a cream background: the top row a leaf with many small specks gathered on it, the bottom row a bottle with the specks all turned away from it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以塑料会一直待着。
一个瓶子扔在野外，
可能要几百年
才会慢慢碎掉。
pages.scene: One plastic bottle lying in grass on a cream background, whole and undamaged. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
碎掉也不是消失。
它只是变成
越来越小的碎片，
小到看不见，
可它还是塑料。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: four stages in a row on a cream background: a bottle, a broken bottle, several small fragments, and many tiny specks. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这些小碎片会被
鱼和鸟吃进肚子。
它们吃不饱，
也吐不出来。
pages.scene: One fish on a cream background with several tiny specks drawn inside its body. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以塑料要扔进
回收桶里。
干净的瓶子可以
重新熔化，
做成新的瓶子或者衣服。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one circular loop of arrows on a cream background with three symbols around it: a bottle, a heap of flakes, and a folded shirt. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
不过回收也有限。
沾了油、沾了饭的塑料
没法回收。
所以扔之前
最好冲一冲。
pages.scene: One clean bottle and one greasy bottle side by side on a cream background, the greasy one with a bold diagonal line across it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最好的办法是少用。
带自己的水杯，
用布袋子买菜，
不要一次性的吸管和叉子。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three symbols in a row on a cream background: a reusable cup, a cloth bag, and a single-use straw with a bold diagonal line across it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
塑料本身不坏。
它轻、结实、便宜，
做水管、做头盔都很好。
只是不该
用一次就扔。
pages.scene: Two objects side by side on a cream background: a sturdy helmet and a length of pipe. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把那个瓶子
冲干净，
扔进了回收桶。
它在草丛里躺了很久，
现在总算能去别的地方了。
pages.scene: The little boy drops a rinsed plastic bottle into a recycling bin, watching it go in.
